I booked for two days and asked for the same room I had last year.
I confirmed my reservation two days before the date.
When I arrived, they told me that the room I had booked was a double, whereas last year it was a single — and no one mentioned that to me during the booking or the confirmation.
Then they told me that all the single rooms were fully booked, so I had no choice but to pay for a double room… even though I’ve been constantly recommending this place to people coming for the DEMS and the master’s exam!

My advice: always ask for a booking confirmation receipt when you make a reservation.

Accueil et propreté au rendez-vous dans un hôtel flambant neuf en plein cœur du coin le plus prisé.
Malgré la proximité avec la promenade hôtel très calme.
Probablement le futur meilleur hôtel de Annaba.
